title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 1+1 TEK ZGJERIMI I REZIDENCES KODRA E DIELLIT 1 ‼️
description_sq:

title_en: APARTMENT 1+1 FOR SALE IN THE EXTENSION OF THE KODRA E DIELLI 1 RESIDENCE ‼️
description_en: • 1+1 Apartment for sale in Kodra e Diellit Residence Extension 1, near the British School. The apartment is located on the first floor of a 6-story building, built in 2017 and equipped with an elevator. The apartment is organized in a corridor that divides the premises, the living room, the bedroom, the toilet and a balcony. • The apartment is newly invested, suitable for residence or investment, as rents in the Residence range from €600 - €700 based on the furniture. The area is quiet, well managed and offers parking for residents. The price of the apartment is 137,000€, customers with credit are also accepted. Contact me for a visit! !
